name: Session Capability
summary: Projects what the current session may do from canonical identity, account, workspace, MFA, and recovery state.

values.name: Anonymous
values.summary: The session has no authenticated identity but may use explicitly permitted guest capabilities.

values.name: Identity Ceremony
values.summary: The session may only continue a PendingIdentity or recovery ceremony.

values.name: Authenticated Limited
values.summary: A durable identity is authenticated but profile, email, workspace, MFA, or recovery gates restrict normal access.

values.name: Authenticated Normal
values.summary: The session may use ordinary application capabilities in the selected workspace.

values.name: Step Up
values.summary: The session has fresh elevated proof for higher-risk operations.

values.name: Blocked
values.summary: The session cannot proceed because the account or state violates an access rule.
